title: Atrof-muhit va jamiyat: sabab, oqibat, yechim va statistika
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ijtimoiy va ekologik muammolarni nomlaysiz, sabab, oqibat va yechimni bog‘laysiz, raqam va foizlardan to‘g‘ri foydalanasiz hamda ikki tomonlama, muvozanatli fikr bilan ikki daqiqa gapira olasiz.

scenes.title: Atrof-muhit va jamiyat
scenes.say_native: Welcome back. Today we are tackling big topics: the environment and society. You will learn to name problems, link causes and effects, suggest solutions, use statistics and give a balanced view.
scenes.say: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda o‘z tajribangiz haqida ikki daqiqalik monolog tuzishni mashq qildik. Bugun esa jiddiyroq mavzuga o‘tamiz: atrof-muhit va jamiyat muammolari. Siz muammoni nomlashni, sabab va oqibatni bog‘lashni, yechim taklif qilishni, raqamlar bilan gapirishni va ikki tomonlama, muvozanatli fikr bildirishni o‘rganasiz. Dars oxirida shu mavzuda mustaqil gapira olasiz.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. Bugun katta mavzularni ko‘ramiz: atrof-muhit va jamiyat. Muammolarni nomlashni, sabab va oqibatni bog‘lashni, yechim taklif qilishni, raqamlardan foydalanishni va muvozanatli fikr bildirishni o‘rganasiz.

scenes.title: Atrof-muhit lug‘ati

examples.t: Air pollution is a serious problem in many big cities.
examples.uz: Havoning ifloslanishi ko‘p yirik shaharlarda jiddiy muammo.

examples.t: Deforestation destroys the homes of wild animals.
examples.uz: O‘rmonlarning kesilishi yovvoyi hayvonlar uyini yo‘q qiladi.

scenes.say_native: Avval atrof-muhit so‘zlarini ko‘ramiz. “Climate change” — iqlim o‘zgarishi, “pollution” — ifloslanish, “deforestation” — o‘rmonlarning kesilishi, “emissions” — atmosferaga chiqariladigan zararli gazlar, “waste” — chiqindi. B2 darajada “ekologiya” deb tarjima qilib “ecology” demang: ecology ilmiy fan nomi, kundalik gapda “the environment” deymiz. Bu so‘zlar insho va nutqda tez-tez uchraydi, shuning uchun ularni gap ichida eslab qoling.
scenes.say: Let's start with the environment. Climate change, pollution, deforestation, greenhouse gas emissions and plastic waste are all part of the same big picture.
scenes.say_uz: Keling, atrof-muhitdan boshlaymiz. Iqlim o‘zgarishi, ifloslanish, o‘rmonlarning kesilishi, issiqxona gazlari va plastik chiqindi — bularning hammasi bitta katta manzaraning qismlari.

scenes.title: Jamiyat lug‘ati

examples.t: Youth unemployment is rising in some regions.
examples.uz: Ba’zi hududlarda yoshlar orasida ishsizlik o‘syapti.

examples.t: Many countries have an ageing population.
examples.uz: Ko‘p mamlakatlarda aholi keksayib bormoqda.

scenes.say_native: Endi jamiyat muammolari. “Poverty” — qashshoqlik, “inequality” — tengsizlik, ya’ni boylar va kambag‘allar orasidagi farq. “Unemployment” — ishsizlik, “homelessness” — uysizlik, “an ageing population” — keksalar ulushi oshib borayotgan aholi. Britaniya imlosida “ageing”, amerikaliklar ko‘pincha “aging” yozadi. Bu so‘zlarning ko‘pi sanalmaydigan ot, shuning uchun oldiga “a” qo‘ymaymiz: poverty, not a poverty.
scenes.say: Now society. Poverty, inequality, unemployment, homelessness and an ageing population are common topics in exams and in the news.
scenes.say_uz: Endi jamiyat. Qashshoqlik, tengsizlik, ishsizlik, uysizlik va keksayib borayotgan aholi — imtihonlarda ham, yangiliklarda ham tez-tez uchraydigan mavzular.

scenes.title: Muammo bilan ishlatiladigan fe’llar
board: tackle / address / combat a problem (muammoni hal qilish)
a pressing issue · a widespread problem

examples.t: The government must tackle homelessness.
examples.uz: Hukumat uysizlik muammosini hal qilishi kerak.

examples.t: The campaign aims to raise awareness of plastic waste.
examples.uz: Kampaniya plastik chiqindi haqida xabardorlikni oshirishni maqsad qilgan.

scenes.say_native: B2 darajada faqat “problem” so‘zini takrorlash yetarli emas. Muammoni “tackle”, “address” yoki “combat” qilamiz, ya’ni unga qarshi chora ko‘ramiz. Biror narsa haqida “raise awareness of” deymiz, ya’ni odamlarni xabardor qilamiz. Muammoning o‘zi esa “a pressing issue” — shoshilinch masala yoki “a widespread problem” — keng tarqalgan muammo bo‘lishi mumkin. Diqqat: “raise awareness of” dan keyin “of” predlogi keladi, “raise awareness about” ham uchraydi, lekin “of” xavfsizroq.
scenes.say: Strong collocations make you sound natural. We tackle or address a problem, we raise awareness of an issue, and we call something a pressing issue or a widespread problem.
scenes.say_uz: Kuchli birikmalar nutqingizni tabiiy qiladi. Muammoni hal qilamiz — tackle yoki address, xabardorlikni oshiramiz — raise awareness of, muammoni esa pressing issue yoki widespread problem deymiz.

scenes.title: Urg‘u: uzun so‘zlarda
scenes.say_native: Uzun so‘zlarda urg‘uni to‘g‘ri qo‘yish tushunarlilikning yarmini hal qiladi. “Environment” — en-VI-ron-ment, urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda; ko‘p o‘quvchilar “n” dan oldingi “i” ni cho‘zib “enviRONment” deydi. “Pollution” — po-LLU-tion. “Unemployment” — un-em-PLOY-ment. “Inequality” — in-e-QUAL-i-ty. “Deforestation” — de-for-es-TA-tion, urg‘u “ta” bo‘g‘inida. Qoida: “-tion” bilan tugaydigan so‘zlarda urg‘u “-tion” dan oldingi bo‘g‘inga tushadi.
scenes.say: Watch the stress. Environment, pollution, unemployment, inequality, deforestation. Say them with me and clap on the stressed syllable.
scenes.say_uz: Urg‘uga e’tibor bering. Environment, pollution, unemployment, inequality, deforestation. Men bilan birga ayting va urg‘uli bo‘g‘inda qarsak chaling.

scenes.title: Ot bilan xatolar
board: ✗ The society needs change. ✓ Society needs change. (umuman)
scenes.say_native: Ikkita tipik xato. Birinchisi: “pollution”, “unemployment”, “poverty” sanalmaydigan otlar, shuning uchun “a pollution” deb bo‘lmaydi. Ikkinchisi: umuman jamiyat haqida gapirsak, artikl qo‘ymaymiz: “Society needs change”, “The society needs change” emas. Artikl faqat aniq bir jamiyatni ko‘zda tutganda kerak: “the society we live in”. O‘zbek tilida artikl yo‘qligi uchun bu xato juda ko‘p uchraydi, shuning uchun bu ikki qoidani yodda tuting.
scenes.say: Common mistakes. Pollution and unemployment are uncountable, so no a. And when we mean society in general, we say society, not the society.
scenes.say_uz: Tipik xatolar. Pollution va unemployment sanalmaydigan otlar, shuning uchun a ishlatilmaydi. Umuman jamiyat haqida gapirsak, the emas, society deymiz.

scenes.title: So‘z birikmalarini to‘ldiring
board: 1) The council wants to ___ air pollution.
2) The campaign will raise ___ of recycling.
scenes.say_native: Gaplarni to‘ldiring. Birinchi gapda “muammoni hal qilish” fe’lini tanlang. Ikkinchisida “xabardorlik” so‘zini toping. Uchinchisida ishga oid muammoni ayting. Har bir gapni baland ovozda to‘liq o‘qing.
scenes.say: Complete the sentences. Number one: the council wants to blank air pollution. Number two: raise blank of recycling. Number three: youth blank is a pressing issue.
scenes.say_uz: Gaplarni to‘ldiring. Birinchi: kengash havoning ifloslanishini ... qilmoqchi. Ikkinchi: qayta ishlash haqida xabardorlikni oshirish. Uchinchi: yoshlar ishsizligi shoshilinch masala.

scenes.title: Javoblar

examples.t: The council wants to tackle air pollution.
examples.uz: Kengash havoning ifloslanishini hal qilmoqchi.

scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi gapda “tackle”, “address” yoki “combat” to‘g‘ri keladi. Ikkinchisida “awareness” — raise awareness of recycling. Uchinchisida “unemployment”, ya’ni ishsizlik. Agar “the unemployment” yoki “a unemployment” degan bo‘lsangiz, avvalgi sahnadagi artikl qoidasini eslang. Uchala gapni to‘liq qaytaring.
scenes.say: Answers. One: tackle, address or combat. Two: awareness. Three: unemployment. Well done.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: tackle, address yoki combat. Ikki: awareness. Uch: unemployment. Barakalla.

scenes.title: Sabab bildirish
board: X is caused by Y · X results from Y · X stems from Y

examples.t: Traffic has increased because more people own cars.
examples.uz: Transport ko‘paydi, chunki ko‘proq odam mashinaga ega.

examples.t: Floods are becoming common due to climate change.
examples.uz: Toshqinlar iqlim o‘zgarishi tufayli tez-tez bo‘lyapti.

scenes.say_native: Muammo haqida gapirganda sababni aniq ko‘rsatish kerak. “Because” dan keyin to‘liq gap keladi: because more people own cars. “Because of”, “due to” va “owing to” dan keyin esa ot yoki ot birikmasi keladi: due to climate change. Fe’l shaklida: “is caused by”, “results from”, “stems from”, ya’ni “kelib chiqadi”. “Due to” va “owing to” yozma nutqda rasmiyroq. O‘zbekchadagi “...li sababli” va “...dan” qo‘shimchalariga qaraganda ingliz tilida bu ishoralar so‘z tartibini o‘zgartiradi, shuning uchun ularni alohida mashq qiling.
scenes.say: To give causes, use because plus a clause, because of or due to plus a noun, and verbs like be caused by, result from and stem from.
scenes.say_uz: Sabab uchun because dan keyin gap, because of yoki due to dan keyin ot ishlating. Fe’llar: be caused by, result from, stem from.

scenes.title: Oqibat bildirish
board: X leads to / results in / contributes to Y

examples.t: Deforestation leads to soil erosion.
examples.uz: O‘rmonlarning kesilishi tuproq eroziyasiga olib keladi.

examples.t: Prices rose. As a result, many families cut spending.
examples.uz: Narxlar oshdi. Natijada ko‘p oilalar xarajatni qisqartirdi.

scenes.say_native: Oqibat uchun uchta asosiy fe’l: “leads to” — olib keladi, “results in” — natijasida … bo‘ladi, “contributes to” — ta’sir qiladigan omillardan biri. Oxirgisi muhim: u bitta emas, bir nechta sababdan biri ekanini bildiradi. Gap boshida esa “As a result”, “Consequently” va “Therefore” ishlatamiz, ulardan keyin vergul qo‘yiladi. Zanjirni davom ettirish uchun “which in turn” — bu esa o‘z navbatida, deymiz.
scenes.say: For effects, use lead to, result in and contribute to. At the start of a sentence, use as a result, consequently or therefore.
scenes.say_uz: Oqibat uchun leads to, results in, contributes to. Gap boshida: as a result, consequently, therefore.

scenes.title: Sabab va oqibatdagi xatolar
board: ✓ because more people drive / because of more drivers
✗ the main reason is because …  ✓ the main reason is that …
scenes.say_native: Uch xato. Birinchisi: “because of” dan keyin gap qo‘yish. “Because of more people drive” noto‘g‘ri; “because more people drive” yoki “because of more drivers” to‘g‘ri. Ikkinchisi: “results to” — yo‘q, faqat “results in”. Uchinchisi: “The reason is because” — ko‘p uchraydi, lekin standart yozma ingliz tilida “The reason is that …” deyiladi. Imtihonda bu xatolar ball yo‘qotadi.
scenes.say: Watch out. Because of needs a noun. Result in, not result to. And the reason is that, not the reason is because.
scenes.say_uz: Ehtiyot bo‘ling. Because of dan keyin ot keladi. Result in, result to emas. Va the reason is that, the reason is because emas.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri bog‘lovchini tanlang
board: 2) Pollution ___ (results to / results in) health problems.
3) Rents went up. ___, fewer people can buy homes.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapni tanlang. Birinchisida ot keladi, demak qaysi shakl kerak? Ikkinchisida to‘g‘ri predlogni tanlang. Uchinchi gapda oldingi gapning natijasini boshlaydigan so‘z kerak. Baland ovozda javob bering.
scenes.say: Choose the correct form. One: because or because of. Two: results to or results in. Three: a linking word for a result.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta gapni to‘ldiring: because yoki because of; results to yoki results in; natijani bildiruvchi bog‘lovchi so‘z.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi gapda “unemployment” — ot, shuning uchun “because of”. Ikkinchisida “results in”, “results to” emas. Uchinchisida “As a result”, “Consequently” yoki “Therefore” mos, hammasidan keyin vergul bor. Agar bittasini adashgan bo‘lsangiz, tashvish qilmang: xatoni topib tuzatish ham o‘rganish.
scenes.say: Answers. One: because of. Two: results in. Three: as a result, consequently or therefore.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: because of. Ikki: results in. Uch: as a result, consequently yoki therefore.

scenes.title: Yechim taklif qilish
board: We could / should / need to + fe’l
One way to tackle this is to … · Governments ought to …

examples.t: One way to reduce waste is to charge for plastic bags.
examples.uz: Chiqindini kamaytirishning bir yo‘li — plastik paketlar uchun haq olish.

examples.t: Governments should invest in public transport.
examples.uz: Hukumatlar jamoat transportiga sarmoya kiritishi kerak.

scenes.say_native: Yechim taklif qilishda “should” — kuchli tavsiya, “could” — yumshoqroq imkoniyat, “need to” — zarurat. Chiroyli ibora: “One way to tackle this is to …” va “It would help if …”. Fe’llarni ham boyiting: “introduce a law” — qonun joriy qilish, “ban” — taqiqlash, “invest in” — mablag‘ kiritish, “encourage people to” — odamlarni rag‘batlantirish. Eslatma: “encourage” dan keyin odam va “to” bilan fe’l keladi.
scenes.say: For solutions, use should, could and need to. One way to tackle this is to… And use strong verbs: introduce, ban, invest in, encourage.
scenes.say_uz: Yechim uchun should, could, need to ishlating. One way to tackle this is to... Kuchli fe’llar: introduce, ban, invest in, encourage.

scenes.title: Yumshoq taklif
board: It would help to … · It might be worth …
would be unlikely to solve it on its own

examples.t: Higher taxes on cars could go some way towards cutting traffic.
examples.uz: Mashinalarga yuqori soliq tirbandlikni kamaytirishga qisman yordam berishi mumkin.

examples.t: Education alone would be unlikely to solve the problem.
examples.uz: Faqat ta’limning o‘zi muammoni hal qilmaydi.

scenes.say_native: Haqiqiy muammolarni bitta chora bilan hal qilib bo‘lmaydi, shuning uchun B2 darajada ishonarli yechim yumshoq ham bo‘lishi kerak. “Could go some way towards solving it” — muammoni qisman hal qilishga yordam beradi. “It would help to …” va “It might be worth …” — foydali bo‘lardi. “Would be unlikely to solve it on its own” — yolg‘iz o‘zi yetarli bo‘lmaydi. Bunday iboralar fikringizni mutlaq emas, o‘ylangan qilib ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: Real problems are rarely solved by one measure, so sound realistic: could go some way towards, it would help to, would be unlikely to solve it alone.
scenes.say_uz: Real muammolar bitta chora bilan hal bo‘lmaydi, shuning uchun realistik gapiring: could go some way towards, it would help to, would be unlikely to solve it alone.

scenes.title: Zanjir: sabab, oqibat, yechim
board: Heavy traffic → air pollution → better buses
scenes.say_native: Mana bitta paragrafda uchala element. Avval sabab: ko‘p odam ishga yakka o‘zi mashinada boradi. Keyin oqibat: havo ifloslanadi va bu o‘z navbatida astma kabi kasalliklarga hissa qo‘shadi. Oxirida yechim: arzon va ishonchli avtobuslarga sarmoya kiritish. Sabab, oqibat, yechim tartibini eslab qoling: insho va og‘zaki javobda ham shu tartib ishonarli eshitiladi.
scenes.say: Heavy traffic is mainly caused by the number of people who drive to work alone. This leads to air pollution, which in turn contributes to asthma. One way to tackle it is to invest in cheap, reliable buses.
scenes.say_uz: Gavjum yo‘llar asosan ishga yakka o‘zi mashinada boradigan odamlar ko‘pligidan kelib chiqadi. Bu havoning ifloslanishiga olib keladi, o‘z navbatida astmaga hissa qo‘shadi. Hal qilishning bir yo‘li — arzon, ishonchli avtobuslarga sarmoya kiritish.

scenes.title: O‘z zanjiringizni tuzing
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz. Mavzu: daryolardagi plastik chiqindi. Bitta sabab, bitta oqibat va bitta yechim aytib, uchta to‘liq gap tuzing. Sabab uchun “caused by” yoki “because”, oqibat uchun “leads to”, yechim uchun “One way to … is to …” ishlating.
scenes.say: Build your own chain about plastic waste in rivers. Give one cause, one effect and one solution, each in a full sentence.
scenes.say_uz: Daryolardagi plastik chiqindi haqida zanjir tuzing: bitta sabab, bitta oqibat, bitta yechim, har biri to‘liq gap bilan.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: Solution: charge for bags, improve recycling

examples.t: Plastic in rivers is largely caused by single-use packaging.
examples.uz: Daryolardagi plastik asosan bir martalik qadoqdan kelib chiqadi.

examples.t: This harms wildlife, so one way to tackle it is to charge for bags.
examples.uz: Bu yovvoyi tabiatga zarar beradi, shuning uchun uni hal qilishning yo‘li — paket uchun haq olish.

scenes.say_native: Namuna javob: daryolardagi plastik asosan bir martalik qadoqdan kelib chiqadi; bu baliq va yovvoyi tabiatga zarar yetkazadi; hal qilishning bir yo‘li — paketlar uchun haq olish va qayta ishlashni yaxshilash. Sizning javobingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin va bu yaxshi. Muhimi, uchala qism ham bor edimi, bog‘lovchilar to‘g‘ri ishlatildimi. Yo‘q bo‘lsa, yana bir marta urinib ko‘ring.
scenes.say: A possible answer: Plastic in rivers is largely caused by single-use packaging. This harms fish and wildlife, so one way to tackle it is to charge for bags and improve recycling.
scenes.say_uz: Mumkin javob: daryolardagi plastik asosan bir martalik qadoqdan kelib chiqadi. Bu baliq va yovvoyi tabiatga zarar beradi, shuning uchun yechim — paketlar uchun haq olish va qayta ishlashni yaxshilash.

scenes.title: Tinglash: radio suhbat
board: Listen: What changed? What was the result?
scenes.say_native: Endi radio suhbatni tinglang. Ikkita savolga e’tibor bering: nima o‘zgardi va natija nima bo‘ldi? Suhbatda foiz, natija bog‘lovchisi va yechimning cheklangani haqida gap boradi. Birinchi tinglashda umumiy ma’noni tushunishga harakat qiling, mayda so‘zlarga ilinib qolmang.
scenes.say: Presenter: Since the shop charge for bags began, what has changed? Expert: Quite a lot. Bag use fell by roughly eighty per cent in the first year. As a result, far less plastic ends up in local rivers. Presenter: Is that enough? Expert: Not on its own, but it has raised awareness, which encourages people to recycle more.
scenes.say_uz: Boshlovchi: Do‘konlarda paket uchun haq olina boshlagandan beri nima o‘zgardi? Mutaxassis: Ancha narsa. Birinchi yilda paketlardan foydalanish taxminan sakson foizga kamaydi. Natijada mahalliy daryolarga ancha kam plastik tushadi. Boshlovchi: Bu yetarlimi? Mutaxassis: Yolg‘iz o‘zi emas, lekin u xabardorlikni oshirdi va odamlarni ko‘proq qayta ishlashga undaydi.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 1) How much did bag use fall?
2) What is the result for the rivers?
3) Is the charge enough on its own?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: paketlardan foydalanish qancha kamaydi? Ikkinchi: daryolar uchun natija nima? Uchinchi: mutaxassis haq olishni yetarli deb hisoblaydimi? Javobni to‘liq gap bilan aytishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: Three questions. How much did bag use fall? What is the result for the rivers? Is the charge enough on its own?
scenes.say_uz: Uchta savol. Paketlardan foydalanish qancha kamaydi? Daryolar uchun natija nima? Haq olishning o‘zi yetarlimi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 2) Far less plastic ends up in rivers
3) No — it helps, but not on its own
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: taxminan sakson foizga. Ikkinchi: daryolarga ancha kam plastik tushadi. Uchinchi: yo‘q, o‘zi yetarli emas, lekin xabardorlikni oshiradi. Eslang, mutaxassis “Not on its own” deb yumshoq ohangda cheklov qo‘ydi. Aynan shunday realistik javob B2 imtihonida yuqori baho oladi.
scenes.say: Answers. One: by roughly eighty per cent. Two: far less plastic reaches the rivers. Three: no, it is not enough on its own, but it raises awareness.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: taxminan sakson foizga. Ikki: daryolarga ancha kam plastik tushadi. Uch: yo‘q, o‘zi yetarli emas, lekin xabardorlikni oshiradi.

scenes.title: Ulushni ifodalash
board: 40% = forty per cent · a third (33%) · a quarter (25%)
one in five · nearly half · the majority · a minority

examples.t: Nearly half of the residents use public transport.
examples.uz: Aholining deyarli yarmi jamoat transportidan foydalanadi.

examples.t: One in five young people is unemployed here.
examples.uz: Bu yerda har besh yoshdan biri ishsiz.

scenes.say_native: Statistika haqida gapirishda ulushni turli usullar bilan aytish mumkin. Aniq foiz: forty per cent. Kasr: a third, a quarter, two thirds. “One in five” — har beshtadan bittasi. Taxminiy: “nearly half” — deyarli yarmi, “the majority” — ko‘pchilik, “a minority” — ozchilik. Muhim: “per cent” ko‘plik qo‘shimchasini olmaydi, “percents” demaymiz. Britaniya imlosida ikki so‘z, amerikada bir so‘z: percent.
scenes.say: To talk about proportions, use per cent, a third, a quarter, one in five, nearly half, the majority and a minority.
scenes.say_uz: Ulushni aytish uchun per cent, a third, a quarter, one in five, nearly half, the majority va a minority ishlating.

scenes.title: Tendensiyani tasvirlash
board: rise / increase / grow · fall / drop / decline
remain stable · double · halve · peak at

examples.t: The number of cyclists doubled between 2015 and 2020.
examples.uz: Velosipedchilar soni 2015 va 2020 yillar orasida ikki baravar oshdi.

examples.t: Unemployment fell slightly, then remained stable.
examples.uz: Ishsizlik biroz kamaydi, keyin barqaror qoldi.

scenes.say_native: Tendensiyani tasvirlash uchun fe’l va ravishni birga ishlating. O‘sish: rise, increase, grow. Kamayish: fall, drop, decline. Ravishlar: “sharply” — keskin, “steadily” — barqaror, “slightly” — biroz, “gradually” — asta-sekin. Yana “remain stable” — o‘zgarishsiz qolmoq, “double” — ikki baravar oshmoq, “halve” — yarmiga kamaymoq. Eslatma: “rise” obyektsiz fe’l, “raise” esa obyekt talab qiladi: Prices rose. The shop raised prices.
scenes.say: To describe change, use rose, fell, remained stable, doubled or halved, with adverbs like sharply, steadily or slightly.
scenes.say_uz: O‘zgarishni rose, fell, remained stable, doubled, halved kabi fe’llar va sharply, steadily, slightly kabi ravishlar bilan tasvirlang.

scenes.title: Predloglar: by, to, from, at

examples.t: Recycling rose from 20 to 35 per cent.
examples.uz: Qayta ishlash 20 foizdan 35 foizgacha oshdi.

examples.t: The rate increased by 5 per cent.
examples.uz: Ko‘rsatkich 5 foizga oshdi.

scenes.say_native: Statistikada predlog juda muhim. “By” o‘zgarish miqdorini bildiradi: increased by ten per cent, ya’ni o‘n foizga. “To” oxirgi raqamni ko‘rsatadi: increased to fifty per cent, ya’ni ellik foizgacha. “From … to …” boshlanish va oxirgi nuqtani beradi. “At” cho‘qqi yoki darajani ko‘rsatadi: peaked at forty per cent. O‘zbek tilida bu farq “-ga” qo‘shimchasi ichida yo‘qoladi, shuning uchun ingliz tilida alohida ehtiyot bo‘ling.
scenes.say: Use by for the size of a change, to for the final figure, from and to for a range, and at for a peak.
scenes.say_uz: By o‘zgarish miqdorini, to oxirgi raqamni, from va to oraliqni, at cho‘qqini bildiradi.

scenes.title: Taxminiy raqamlar
board: just over / just under · well over · almost

examples.t: Just over 30 per cent of adults volunteer.
examples.uz: Kattalarning 30 foizdan biroz ko‘prog‘i ko‘ngilli bo‘lib ishlaydi.

examples.t: Almost a third of homes have no recycling bin.
examples.uz: Uylarning deyarli uchdan birida qayta ishlash chelagi yo‘q.

scenes.say_native: Har doim aniq raqam kerak emas. “Roughly”, “approximately”, “around” — taxminan. “Just over” — biroz ko‘proq, “just under” — biroz kam, “well over” — ancha ko‘p, “almost” — deyarli. Yana “a significant proportion” — sezilarli ulush, “a tiny proportion” — juda kichik ulush. Bu iboralar faktni sovuq raqamdan tirik fikrga aylantiradi va ishonchli tuyuladi.
scenes.say: When numbers are not exact, say roughly, approximately, around, just over, just under, well over or almost.
scenes.say_uz: Raqam aniq bo‘lmasa, roughly, approximately, around, just over, just under, well over yoki almost deng.

scenes.title: Statistikadagi xatolar
board: ✗ the number of people are · ✓ the number of people is
scenes.say_native: Uchta tipik xato. Birinchisi: “The number of people is …” — birlik fe’l, chunki “number” asosiy so‘z; “A number of people are …” esa ko‘plik, “bir necha odam” ma’nosida. Ikkinchisi: sanaladigan otlar bilan “fewer”, sanalmaydigan bilan “less”: fewer people, less pollution. Uchinchisi: o‘zgarish miqdoridan oldin “by” tushib qolishi. Bular imtihonda eng ko‘p kesib tashlanadigan joylar.
scenes.say: Three classic mistakes. The number of takes a singular verb. Fewer with countable nouns. And by before the size of a change.
scenes.say_uz: Uchta klassik xato. The number of birlik fe’l oladi. Sanaladigan otlar bilan fewer. O‘zgarish miqdoridan oldin by.

scenes.title: Jadvalni gapga aylantiring
board: Say 3 sentences using rose / remained / by / to
scenes.say_native: Jadvalga qarang: A shahrida qayta ishlash ulushi 2010 yilda yigirma, 2015 yilda o‘ttiz besh, 2020 yilda yana o‘ttiz besh, 2024 yilda esa ellik foiz. Uchta gap ayting: o‘sishni, barqarorlikni va umumiy o‘zgarishni tasvirlang. Predloglar “by” va “to” ni to‘g‘ri tanlang.
scenes.say: Look at the table. Say three sentences about the recycling rate in Town A using rose, remained stable, by and to.
scenes.say_uz: Jadvalga qarang. A shahrida qayta ishlash ulushi haqida uchta gap ayting: o‘sish, barqarorlik va umumiy o‘zgarish.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: Between 2010 and 2015, the rate rose from 20 to 35 per cent.
By 2024 it had increased to 50 per cent, a rise of 15 points.
scenes.say_native: Namuna javoblar: 2010 va 2015 yillar orasida ko‘rsatkich yigirma foizdan o‘ttiz besh foizgacha oshdi. Keyin 2020 yilgacha barqaror qoldi. 2024 yilga kelib esa ellik foizga yetdi. Eslatma: oxirgi qadam o‘ttiz besh foizdan ellikka, ya’ni o‘n besh punktga oshish. Bu yerda foiz ulushi va “punkt” o‘rtasidagi farqni ko‘ryapsiz: 35 dan 50 gacha o‘sish 15 foiz punkt, lekin nisbiy o‘sish taxminan 43 foiz.
scenes.say: Possible answers. Between 2010 and 2015, the rate rose from twenty to thirty-five per cent. It then remained stable until 2020. By 2024 it had increased to fifty per cent.
scenes.say_uz: Namunaviy javoblar. 2010 va 2015 orasida ko‘rsatkich yigirma foizdan o‘ttiz besh foizgacha oshdi. Keyin 2020 gacha barqaror qoldi. 2024 ga kelib ellik foizga yetdi.

scenes.title: Manbani ko‘rsatish

examples.t: According to the survey, most residents support the scheme.
examples.uz: So‘rovnomaga ko‘ra, aholining ko‘pchiligi loyihani qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi.

examples.t: The figures suggest that the problem is growing.
examples.uz: Raqamlar muammo kengayayotganini ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.say_native: Raqam keltirsangiz, manbani ayting: “According to a recent survey”. Xulosa chiqarishda esa ehtiyot bo‘ling: “suggests” — ko‘rsatadi, ishora qiladi, “indicates” — bildiradi, “shows” — aniq ko‘rsatadi, “proves” — isbotlaydi. Bitta so‘rovnoma hech narsani isbotlamaydi, shuning uchun “suggests” xavfsizroq. Va eng muhimi: raqam to‘qimang. Agar aniq bilmasangiz, “roughly” yoki “a large proportion” deb gapiring, yolg‘on aniq raqamdan yaxshiroq.
scenes.say: Always say where numbers come from. According to a survey, research suggests, the figures indicate. Use suggest, not prove, when evidence is limited.
scenes.say_uz: Raqamning manbasini ayting: according to a survey, research suggests, the figures indicate. Dalil cheklangan bo‘lsa, prove emas, suggest deng.

scenes.title: Tinglash: tirbandlik haqida
board: Listen: What do they agree on? What do they disagree on?
scenes.say_native: Ikki talaba shahar markazini mashinalardan ozod qilish haqida gaplashadi. Ikki narsaga quloq soling: ular nimada kelishadi va nimadan ehtiyot bo‘lishadi. Dialogda foiz, manba va shartli kelishuv ishlatilgan. Birinchi marta umumiy ma’noni tushuning, ikkinchi marta tafsilotlarga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Lena: A recent survey says just over sixty per cent of residents want a car-free centre. Omar: That's a clear majority, but shops worry about losing customers. Lena: True, though in other cities sales rose after the change. Omar: Then I agree, as long as buses become cheaper.
scenes.say_uz: Lena: So‘nggi so‘rovnomaga ko‘ra, aholining oltmish foizdan biroz ko‘prog‘i markazda mashina bo‘lmasligini xohlaydi. Omar: Bu aniq ko‘pchilik, lekin do‘konlar mijoz yo‘qotishdan xavotirda. Lena: To‘g‘ri, ammo boshqa shaharlarda o‘zgarishdan keyin savdo oshgan. Omar: Unda roziman, agar avtobuslar arzonlashsa.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) How many residents want a car-free centre?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: necha foiz aholi markazning mashinasiz bo‘lishini xohlaydi? Ikkinchi: do‘konlar nimadan xavotirda? Uchinchi: Omar qanday shart qo‘yadi? Ishonchingiz komil bo‘lmasa ham taxmin qilib, to‘liq gap bilan ayting.
scenes.say: Questions. One: how many residents want a car-free centre? Two: what do shops worry about? Three: what condition does Omar set?
scenes.say_uz: Savollar. Necha foiz aholi mashinasiz markazni xohlaydi? Do‘konlar nimadan xavotirda? Omar qanday shart qo‘yadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: oltmish foizdan biroz ko‘proq. Ikkinchi: mijozlarni yo‘qotishdan. Uchinchi: avtobuslar arzonlashishi shart. Diqqat qiling: Omar “as long as” bilan shart qo‘ydi, ya’ni “agar … bo‘lsa”. Bu ibora kelishuvni muvozanatli qiladi: roziman, lekin shart bilan. Keyingi bo‘limda aynan muvozanatli fikr bildirish usullarini o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Answers. One: just over sixty per cent. Two: losing customers. Three: buses must become cheaper.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar. Bir: oltmish foizdan biroz ko‘proq. Ikki: mijozlarni yo‘qotishdan. Uch: avtobuslar arzonlashishi kerak.

scenes.title: Muvozanatli fikr tuzilmasi
scenes.say_native: Muvozanatli javob to‘rt qadamdan iborat. Birinchi: mavzuni qisqa nomlang. Ikkinchi: bir tomonni sababi bilan keltiring. Uchinchi: boshqa tomonni ham sababi bilan ayting. To‘rtinchi: o‘z fikringizni bildiring, yaxshisi shart bilan. Ko‘p o‘quvchilar faqat o‘z fikrini aytib to‘xtaydi va bu eng katta kamchilik. Muvozanat boshqa fikrni hurmat qilishni ko‘rsatadi, shu bilan birga sizning o‘z pozitsiyangiz ham aniq bo‘lishi kerak.
scenes.say: A balanced answer has four steps. State the issue, present one side, present the other side, then give your own view, usually with a condition.
scenes.say_uz: Muvozanatli javob to‘rt qadam: mavzuni nomlang, bir tomonni keltiring, ikkinchi tomonni keltiring, keyin o‘z fikringizni, ko‘pincha shart bilan, ayting.

scenes.title: Tomonlarni bog‘lash
board: On the one hand, … On the other hand, …

examples.t: Although cars are convenient, they cause pollution.
examples.uz: Mashinalar qulay bo‘lsa-da, ifloslanishga sabab bo‘ladi.

examples.t: Admittedly, it is expensive. That said, it saves money in the long run.
examples.uz: To‘g‘ri, qimmat. Shunday bo‘lsa-da, uzoq muddatda pul tejaydi.

scenes.say_native: Ikki tomonni bog‘lash uchun shunday vositalar bor. “On the one hand … on the other hand …” — bir tomondan … ikkinchi tomondan. “Although”, “while”, “whereas” bitta gapda zid fikrni birlashtiradi. “Admittedly” — tan olish kerakki, “That said” — shunday bo‘lsa-da. Bu yerda uchta narsani yodda tuting. “Although” dan keyin “but” ishlatmang: Although it is expensive, it is useful. “But” bilan birga bo‘lmaydi. O‘zbekchada “-sa ham, lekin” deyishimiz mumkin, ingliz tilida esa bittasi yetarli.
scenes.say: To connect two sides, use on the one hand, on the other hand, although, while, whereas, admittedly and that said.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki tomonni on the one hand, on the other hand, although, while, whereas, admittedly va that said bilan bog‘lang.

scenes.title: Ehtiyotkor ifodalar
board: It could be argued that … · Arguably, …
to some extent · in many cases · largely

examples.t: Cities tend to have higher pollution levels.
examples.uz: Shaharlarda ifloslanish darajasi odatda yuqori bo‘ladi.

examples.t: It could be argued that individuals matter less than governments.
examples.uz: Shaxslar hukumatlarga qaraganda kamroq ahamiyatga ega, deb ham bahslashish mumkin.

scenes.say_native: Mutlaq gaplardan saqlaning. “Everyone knows” yoki “always” kabi so‘zlar bahsda zaif eshitiladi. Buning o‘rniga “tend to” — odatda bo‘ladi, “can be” va “may” — mumkin, “arguably” — bahslashish mumkinki, “to some extent” — ma’lum darajada, “in many cases” — ko‘p hollarda. Masalan, “Cars cause pollution” o‘rniga “Cars can be a major source of pollution”. Bu ohang B2 darajaning belgisi.
scenes.say: Avoid absolute claims. Use tend to, can be, may, arguably, to some extent and in many cases to sound careful and credible.
scenes.say_uz: Mutlaq gaplardan qoching. Tend to, can be, may, arguably, to some extent, in many cases kabi iboralar nutqni ehtiyotkor va ishonarli qiladi.

scenes.title: Muvozanatdagi xatolar
board: ✗ In my opinion, I think …  ✓ I think … / In my opinion, …
✗ Everybody knows that factories are bad.
✓ Factories can damage the environment, but they also provide jobs.
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: “In my opinion, I think” — ikki marta aytilgan fikr. Bittasini tanlang. Ikkinchisi: “Everybody knows …” — isbotsiz mutlaq gap. Uchinchisi: faqat salbiy yoki faqat ijobiy ko‘rsatish. Misol: “Factories can damage the environment, but they also provide jobs.” Bu gapda ikkala tomon bor. Diqqat: “On the other hand” faqat qarama-qarshi tomon kelganda ishlatiladi, shunchaki qo‘shimcha fikr uchun “Moreover” yoki “In addition” kerak.
scenes.say: Mistakes. Don't say in my opinion I think, choose one. Don't say everybody knows. Give both sides: factories can damage the environment, but they also provide jobs.
scenes.say_uz: Xatolar: in my opinion I think emas, bittasini tanlang. Everybody knows demang. Ikkala tomonni keltiring: factories can damage the environment, but they also provide jobs.

scenes.title: Muvozanatli javob tuzing
board: Should cars be banned from city centres?
Give: one advantage, one disadvantage, your view
scenes.say_native: Savol: shahar markazidan mashinalarni taqiqlash kerakmi? Bitta afzallik, bitta kamchilik va o‘z fikringizni shart bilan ayting. “Although” yoki “On the other hand” ni ishlating. To‘liq uchta gap yetarli. Vaqt oling va baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Should cars be banned from city centres? Give one advantage, one disadvantage, and your own view with a condition. Use although or on the other hand.
scenes.say_uz: Shahar markazidan mashinalarni taqiqlash kerakmi? Bitta afzallik, bitta kamchilik va o‘z fikringizni shart bilan ayting.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: Disadvantage: harder for shops and disabled people
View: yes, if public transport improves

examples.t: Although a ban would reduce pollution, it could make life harder for some residents.
examples.uz: Taqiq ifloslanishni kamaytirsa-da, ba’zi aholiga qiyinchilik tug‘dirishi mumkin.

scenes.say_native: Namuna: taqiq havoni tozalaydi va ko‘chalarni xavfsizroq qiladi. Boshqa tomondan, do‘konlar va nogironligi bor odamlar uchun qiyinchilik tug‘dirishi mumkin. Men uni qo‘llab-quvvatlayman, agar jamoat transporti yaxshilansa. Ko‘ryapsizmi: afzallik, kamchilik, shart bilan fikr. “Provided” va “as long as” ikkalasi ham “agar … bo‘lsa” degani, lekin shart ma’nosida kuchli.
scenes.say: A model answer: A ban would clean the air and make streets safer. On the other hand, it could make life harder for shops and disabled people. I would support it, provided public transport improves.
scenes.say_uz: Namuna: taqiq havoni tozalaydi va ko‘chalarni xavfsizroq qiladi. Boshqa tomondan, do‘konlar va nogironligi bor odamlar uchun qiyinroq bo‘lishi mumkin. Men qo‘llab-quvvatlayman, agar jamoat transporti yaxshilansa.

scenes.title: Ikki daqiqalik nutq rejasi
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi ikki daqiqalik nutq, shuning uchun rejani hozir ko‘rib chiqamiz. Birinchi yarim daqiqa: muammoni tanishtiring va bitta aniq yoki taxminiy statistika keltiring. Keyingi yarim daqiqa: sabab va oqibatlar. Keyin yechimlar. Oxirgi yarim daqiqa: ikki tomonni ko‘rsating va o‘z fikringizni ayting. Bu reja sizni to‘xtab qolishdan saqlaydi, chunki har lahzada nima aytishni bilasiz.
scenes.say: For a two-minute talk, plan like this. Half a minute introducing the problem with one statistic, then causes and effects, then solutions, and finally both sides with your view.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki daqiqalik nutq uchun reja: yarim daqiqa muammo va bitta statistika, keyin sabab va oqibat, keyin yechim, oxirida ikki tomon va sizning fikringiz.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: gapiring
board: Use: cause · effect · solution · one statistic · both sides
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Mavzu: yoshlar ishsizligi. Taxminan bir daqiqa gapiring. Bitta sabab, bitta oqibat, bitta yechim, bitta taxminiy raqam va ikki tomonni ishlating. Raqamni to‘qimaslik uchun “roughly” yoki “a significant proportion” deb gapiring. Boshlang: “Youth unemployment is a pressing issue in many countries.”
scenes.say: Now your task. Speak about youth unemployment for about one minute. Use a cause, an effect, a solution, one approximate statistic and both sides.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy topshiriq. Yoshlar ishsizligi haqida taxminan bir daqiqa gapiring: sabab, oqibat, yechim, taxminiy raqam va ikki tomon.

scenes.title: Namuna monolog
scenes.say_native: Namuna: yoshlar ishsizligi shoshilinch masala. U qisman ko‘nikmalar va ish o‘rtasidagi tafovutdan kelib chiqadi, bu esa norozilikka olib keladi. Kasbiy tayyorlov dasturlari yordam berishi mumkin, garchi qimmat bo‘lsa-da. Menimcha, ular arziydi, agar ish beruvchilar ham ishtirok etsa. Sizning javobingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi tabiiy. Tekshiring: sabab, oqibat, yechim va ikki tomon bormi?
scenes.say: Youth unemployment is a pressing issue. It is partly caused by a gap between skills and jobs, which leads to frustration. Training schemes could help, although they are expensive. I think they are worth it, as long as employers are involved.
scenes.say_uz: Yoshlar ishsizligi shoshilinch masala. U qisman ko‘nikmalar va ish o‘rtasidagi tafovutdan kelib chiqadi, bu norozilikka olib keladi. Tayyorlov dasturlari yordam berishi mumkin, garchi qimmat. Menimcha, ular arziydi, agar ish beruvchilar qatnashsa.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: Vocab: tackle, raise awareness, pressing issue
Cause/effect: due to · leads to · as a result
Stats: by / to / from · fewer / less
Balance: although · that said · tend to
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Bugun to‘rt narsani o‘rgandingiz. Birinchi: ijtimoiy muammolar lug‘ati va ularga mos fe’llar. Ikkinchi: sabab, oqibat va yechim iboralari. Uchinchi: statistika, ya’ni foiz, tendensiya, predloglar va taxminiy raqamlar. To‘rtinchi: muvozanatli fikr bildirish, ehtiyotkor iboralar bilan. Agar bu to‘rtala narsani bitta nutqda ishlata olsangiz, B2 darajada gapira olasiz.
scenes.say: Let's recap. You learned social issues vocabulary, cause and effect language, ways to talk about statistics, and how to give a balanced view.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa qilamiz. Siz ijtimoiy muammolar lug‘atini, sabab va oqibat iboralarini, statistika tilini va muvozanatli fikr bildirishni o‘rgandingiz.

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Homework: 2 minutes on a social problem
Success: cause + effect + solution + statistic + both sides
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: bitta ijtimoiy muammoni tanlang va ikki daqiqa gapiring. Nutqda sabab, oqibat, yechim, bitta taxminiy raqam va ikki tomon bo‘lsin. O‘zingizni yozib oling va tinglang. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: ikki daqiqa davomida to‘xtab qolmasdan, shu besh element bilan gapirdingiz. Keyingi darsda esa esse tuzilmasini, ya’ni kirish, dalil va xulosani o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: For homework, choose a social problem and speak about it for two minutes. Include a cause, an effect, a solution, an approximate statistic and both sides. Record yourself and listen back.
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: bitta ijtimoiy muammo haqida ikki daqiqa gapiring: sabab, oqibat, yechim, taxminiy raqam va ikki tomon bilan. O‘zingizni yozib oling.

homework_uz: Bitta ijtimoiy yoki ekologik muammoni tanlang va ikki daqiqa davomida gapiring. Nutqda sabab, oqibat, yechim, bitta taxminiy raqam (to‘qima aniq raqam emas) va ikki tomonlama fikr bo‘lsin. O‘zingizni yozib oling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: to‘xtab qolmasdan, shu besh elementni ishlatdingiz.

options: A pollution is a serious problem.

quiz.q: Heavy rain caused floods. The floods ___ many families losing their homes.
Prices rose ___ the lack of supply.
quiz.why_uz: Keyin ot birikmasi kelgani uchun “because of” kerak.
“The number of” birlik fe’l bilan keladi.

quiz.q: There are ___ jobs than last year.
The rate increased ___ 10 per cent, to 45 per cent.
Which is the most balanced sentence?
options: Cars cause pollution, but they also give people freedom.
I think, in my opinion, cars are bad.
quiz.why_uz: Ikkala tomon ko‘rsatilgan, mutlaq so‘z yo‘q.

quiz.q: ___ it is expensive, public transport is worth supporting.
Where is the main stress in the word “unemployment”?
